name: Xero
summary: Starting is free and self-serve, but your app is capped at 5 connections until you add payment details. Growth moves through paid tiers, and joining the App Store adds customer references and a yearly security assessment.
biggestRisk: Your connection cap, not your code, limits growth. Plan your tier before onboarding your sixth customer.

paths.name: Starter tier, up to 5 connections
paths.whenToUse: You're building, or piloting with a few organizations.

wait.note: No approval step on this path.

steps.title: Register the app
steps.detail: In the Xero developer portal, create a web app and add the Composio redirect URI. Xero's PKCE support is S256 only.
steps.confirm: The app page shows a client ID and you can generate a secret.
steps.handoffReason: This requires a Xero account and accepting developer terms.

steps.title: Test on the Demo Company
steps.detail: Connect the Demo Company first, so your testing doesn't use a real customer's connection.
steps.confirm: Your agent can read invoices from the demo organization.
steps.handoffReason: A person must approve the consent screen.

blockers.action: Add payment details to move to Core, or free up slots with connection management.

paths.name: Paid tiers, up to thousands of connections

wait.note: Moving to Core looks immediate after adding payment details, but we couldn't confirm that. Moves above Core need an application, and we found no stated timing.

steps.title: Estimate your tier
steps.detail: Compare your connection forecast against the tier limits: Core 50, Plus 1,000, Advanced 10,000.
steps.confirm: You know your tier and its monthly fee.

steps.title: Add payment or apply to move up
steps.detail: Add payment details to move to Core. Higher tiers need an application in the developer portal once you meet that tier's requirements.
steps.confirm: The portal shows your new tier.

blockers.symptom: You're stuck at a tier's maximum
blockers.cause: Connections are capped until you meet the next tier's requirements.
blockers.action: Apply in the developer portal and ask Xero what the next tier requires, as we couldn't find the full list.

paths.name: Become an App Store partner
paths.whenToUse: You want to be listed in the Xero App Store.

wait.note: We couldn't find a stated time for certification.

steps.title: Find three customers
steps.detail: Xero's partner guide asks for at least three customers who love your app before certification.
steps.confirm: You have three named customers using the app.
steps.handoffReason: This depends on real customer relationships.

steps.title: Pass certification and security assessment
steps.detail: Work through Xero's certification checkpoints, then complete the security assessment, which repeats yearly.
steps.handoffReason: Xero's security team reviews your submission.

nuances.title: Sources disagree on uncertified limits
nuances.detail: A search result from Xero's connections page said organizations can connect to no more than 5 uncertified apps, while its FAQ gives an example of 2. Older forum posts mention a limit of 25. Check with Xero if this affects you.

nuances.title: Custom Connections are a different model
nuances.detail: They're bought per organization and don't count toward the uncertified limit, so they can suit a single large customer.

nuances.title: Composio can't provide this app
nuances.detail: Xero is listed as bring-your-own, so you'd be subject to these tiers yourself.
